title: Intraday Momentum Basic — Trade ON (VWAP + Green Close)
notes: Entry only after VWAP retouch and a green 5m close above VWAP.
Signal precondition: breakout above previous 6 candles + volume > 2x (20-bar avg) + close > VWAP.
Basic mode: breakout + volume + VWAP only.
Exit shown at day close and +15m from entry.
